method: Rebuilt binary, re-scanned all 210 round-3 projects, ran frozen score.py from docs/audit/raw/final-eval-r3, compared unmatched candidates against labels/fp-adjudicated-aegis.json by (project, rule, resource, title). Genuinely new candidates adjudicated under the documented round-3 criteria. No new eval corpus built.

after.unmatched_note: all 1983 unmatched candidates adjudicated TP/HYGIENE under round-3 criteria

new_candidates_adjudication.justification: Duplicate of the matched nsg-open GT concept (054 matched it); 12 prior 244 instances adjudicated TP the same way.
DaemonSets genuinely define no securityContext at pod or container level; factually correct finding of a real weakness.

intermediate_regression_fixed.cause: Parser fix surfaced network_interface/access_config on NAT fixtures; public IP on a forwarding appliance is by design.
intermediate_regression_fixed.fix: Exempt can_ip_forward=true instances from GCP-017 (commit b495abd); forwarding itself stays flagged. Rescore numbers above are after this fix.

caveats: Point estimates only; no bootstrap CIs recomputed.
The 9 new candidates were adjudicated by the implementing agent under round-3 criteria, not an independent labeler.
KICS round-3 FP rate 0.000 was a 400-finding sample, not full adjudication.
